title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Center: Seller Setup and Operations
summary: A seller-side guide to TikTok Shop Affiliate Center, covering Open and Target Collaboration, creators, samples, commission settings, and measurement.
body_markdown:
## Set commission from economics and measure the full funnel


There is no universal commission rate that is right for every TikTok Shop product. Use the range and controls available in your account, then calculate what the product can sustain. Include expected refunds because an estimated affiliate commission can change as the underlying order moves through cancellation, return, and settlement states. If a product is in both Open and Target Collaboration, review TikTok’s current precedence and rate-protection rules before changing terms.


### Define the decision before choosing the metric


For recruitment, measure creators reviewed, qualified, contacted, responses, acceptances, and cost per accepted collaboration. For sampling, measure requests, approvals, shipments, deliveries, posts, sample-to-post rate, and cost per posted asset. For commerce, review content, clicks where available, orders, GMV under the report’s definition, cancellations, refunds, commission, and contribution margin. Reconcile Affiliate Center data with order and finance records rather than treating GMV as cash received or profit.


Compare cohorts by product, creator, collaboration type, and time period. A creator who produces fewer orders with lower refunds and repeatable content may be more valuable than one with a larger top-line GMV number and weak margin.
